==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|fro|priorite}}, from {{der|en|la|priōritās}}.

Surface analysis: {{suffix|en|prior|ity|nocat=1}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/pɹaɪˈɒɹɪti/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/pɹaɪˈɔɹɪtɪj/|a=SSB}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-priority.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{enPR|prī-ôrə-tē|a=GA,CA}}, {{IPA|en|/pɹaɪˈoɹəti/|[pɹaɪˈoɹəɾi]}}
* {{IPA|en|/pɹaɪˈɑɹəti/|[pɹaɪˈɑɹəɾi]|a=NYC,Philadelphia,Baltimore}}
* {{IPA|en|/pɹɑeˈɔɹəti/|[pɹɑe̯ˈɔɹəɾi]|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/pɹaɪˈɒɹəti/|[pɹɑe̯ˈɔ̟ɹəɾi]|a=NZ}}
* {{IPA|en|/pɾaɪˈɔɾɪte/|a=Scotland}}
* {{IPA|en|/pɾaɪˈɒɾɪti/|a=Wales}}
* {{hyph|en|pri|or|i|ty}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɒɹɪti|s=4}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# An item's relative importance.
#: {{ux|en|He set his e-mail message's '''priority''' to high.}}
# A goal of a person or an organisation.
#: {{ux|en|She needs to get her '''priorities''' straight and stop playing games.}}
# The quality of being earlier or coming first compared to another thing; the state of being [[prior]]. <!--is this not just same as sense 1?-->
#: {{ux|en|In bankruptcy law, a business' debt to its employees has '''priority''' over its debt to a landlord, so the employees must be paid first.}}
# {{lb|en|taxonomy|of a name}} A [[superior]] claim to use by virtue of being [[validly]] [[publish]]ed at an earlier date.
#* {{RQ:Schuster Hepaticae|volume=V|page=viii|text=Neither [Jones]{{...}} nor I (in 1966) could conceive of reducing our "science" to the ultimate absurdity of reading Finnish newspapers almost a century and a half old in order to establish "'''priority'''."}}
# [[precedence|Precedence]]; superior [[rank]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1998|author=Mary Whitby|title=The Propaganda of Power: The Role of Panegyric in Late Antiquity|publisher=BRILL|isbn=9789004105713|page=308
|text=Sozomen is not criticizing Constantine but rather asserting that bishops have '''priority''' over emperors, in case the readers might not have understood this {{...}}}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2007-11-01|author=Muhammad Saed Abdul-Rahman|title=Islam: Questions and Answers - Manners (Part 1)|publisher=MSA Publication Limited|isbn=9781861793362|page=301
|text=Who has '''priority''', one's mother or one's wife? Question: To whom should a married man should give much preference, either his mother or wife?}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2010-01-01|author=A. W. Tozer|title=Tozer Speaks to Students: Chapel Messages Preached at Wheaton College|publisher=Moody Publishers|isbn=9781600663291
|text=The Holy Ghost is here and He has '''priority'''—remember that. The Holy Ghost has '''priority''' over your pastor, your church, your teachers—'''priority''' over every human thing. He is God, and being God, His voice has '''priority''' over all voices,{{nb...}}}}
# {{lb|en|transport}} [[right of way|Right of way]]; The right to pass (an intersection) before other road users.

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|state of being prior}} See [[Thesaurus:anteriority]]
* {{sense|superior rank}} {{l|en|dignity}}, {{l|en|eminence}}, {{l|en|seniority}}, {{l|en|superiority}}

====Antonyms====
* {{sense|state of not focusing or prioritizing}} [[disfocus]]

====Derived terms====

|aperture priority|prioritise,prioritize|prioritization|shutter priority|top priority|aperture-priority|Marcan priority|priority queue|Markan priority|priority seat|priority road|get one's priorities right|get one's priorities straight}}
